categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in IC design focusing on touchscreen controllers, touchpad modules, pointing devices, and biometric chips including fingerprint and facial recognition. It also develops microcontrollers and automotive electronics such as ADAS and smart cockpit solutions. The business segments include both touch and non-touch product lines, with a strong emphasis on notebook-related input devices and expanding into automotive and smart card markets.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include advanced IC design for touchscreens, touchpads with haptic feedback, AI integration in chips, biometric security features, and high-resolution image processing for automotive applications. Production involves design in-house, mask making, wafer fabrication by leading foundries (TSMC, UMC, etc.), wafer testing, packaging, and final testing. The company holds numerous patents across Taiwan, Japan, China, and the US, and applies ISO 14001, ISO 45001, and ISO 9001 standards in operations.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are global leading brands in notebooks, smartphones, tablets, AI PCs, and automotive electronics. The company serves major notebook brands, ODMs, panel manufacturers, and smartphone module suppliers worldwide. The automotive segment targets electric buses, large buses, and plans expansion into logistics and taxis, primarily in Taiwan and Southeast Asia. The smart card market includes credit cards, financial cards, and ID cards.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly from Taiwan with headquarters and manufacturing sites in Hsinchu and Zhonghe. It has a global sales and marketing network covering Taiwan, China, Hong Kong, and other international markets. The majority of sales revenue comes from Hong Kong (71.45%), followed by China (18.75%) and Taiwan (7.81%). It also collaborates with international partners in the US, Japan, Europe, and China.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company is positioned primarily in the midstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain, focusing on IC design and module assembly. It relies on upstream wafer foundries and mask makers for manufacturing and downstream customers for integration into end products. It maintains close partnerships with foundries, packaging, and testing service providers, and collaborates with ODMs and brand customers for product development and sales.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening AI integration in products, expanding automotive electronics (ADAS, smart cockpit), enhancing biometric security features, and developing new applications such as smart cards and chargers. The company invests over 18% of revenue in R&D, focusing on AI-enabled touch solutions, haptic feedback, embedded touchscreens (SLOC), and high dynamic range imaging. It also pursues sustainability through energy management and green building initiatives.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of IC chips and modules to global brand customers and ODMs. The company offers integrated solutions combining hardware and software features, with a modular sales approach including single-chip and multi-chip modules. Licensing or royalties are not explicitly mentioned. Revenue is diversified across notebook input devices, automotive electronics, and biometric solutions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading global market position in notebook touchscreen controllers, touchpad modules, and pointing devices, ranking first worldwide in these segments. It competes with other IC design firms in Taiwan, the US, Japan, and China, especially in biometric and automotive electronics. Its differentiation lies in strong AI integration, extensive patents, and close collaboration with top-tier global customers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, consolidated revenue reached approximately NT$12.7 billion with a gross margin of 48.9% and operating margin of 24.1%. Net income attributable to the parent company was NT$2.74 billion, reflecting a 5.29% revenue growth and over 25% operating profit increase year-over-year. The company maintains a strong financial position with total assets of NT$15 billion and equity of NT$10 billion, investing heavily in capital expenditures such as a new AI smart park facility.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes innovative AI-enabled touch and biometric solutions that enhance user experience and security, such as AI touchpads with palm rejection and waterproof features, and advanced fingerprint recognition with anti-spoofing. Its modular product offerings and strong R&D capabilities enable customized solutions for diverse applications from notebooks to automotive electronics. Sustainability efforts and global customer partnerships further differentiate its market position.
